method: Human-authorized seventh verification round (Jaden, 2026-10-10: 'run a fresh independent verifier round for the behavior research stages'; re-sample after fixing mismatches; 2026-10-11: budget-friendly path approved). Before this round, both round-6 mismatches were fixed against the archived documents (OHM-053 saturation-current test condition; OHM-174 catalogue revision prose), a scan of all 180 gap-fills aligned ten 'Sources opened' revision lines with the verified document metadata, OHM-053's turns ratio took the page 1 default test conditions, and origin/main (#47-#56) was merged, keeping this branch's third-party-copy provenance labels. New integer seeds drawn once with secrets.randbits(63) before the samples were computed. One fresh-context reviewer agent per sampled entry (Claude Sonnet, chosen for cost) with instructions narrowed for cost: text extraction with word coordinates first, at most four cropped renders at 150 dpi or less, and spot checks of digitized curve points instead of full re-digitization. Reviewers read only the entry gapfill, its generated record, FETCH_LEDGER.jsonl (URL-to-SHA256 mapping only) and the archived primary-source bytes; no web access, no other repository files, no prior verifier reports. Values, units, conditions, min/typ/max qualifiers, document metadata and provenance claims were re-derived; page-citation drift with the value present elsewhere in the same document is recorded as a note.

notes: Document identified from bytes: Texas Instruments 'SNx4HC245 Octal Bus Transceivers With 3-State Outputs' (covers SN54HC245 and SN74HC245), doc SCLS131F, December 1982 - revised August 2022, 35 pages, blob sha 31514d93...; pages read with word coordinates: 1, 3, 4, 5, plus text-search hits on p.2 (revision line) and p.15 (orderable addendum); no images rendered.

operating_ambient_range [-40, 85] degC: OK p.4 Table 6.3 TA row, SN74HC245 group (SN54HC245 group is -55 to 125 degC, correctly not used).

input_capacitance_typical 3 pF: OK p.5 Table 6.5, Ci for DIR or OE, VCC 2 V to 6 V, value sits in the TA = 25 degC TYP column (MAX is 10 pF in all three MAX columns), so the typical-at-25C scope is correct.

input_leakage_max 1 uA: OK p.5 Table 6.5, II for DIR or OE, VI = VCC or 0, VCC 6 V, SN74HC245 MAX +/-1000 nA (25 degC typ +/-0.1 nA and 25 degC max +/-100 nA correctly not used). off_state_output_leakage_max 5 uA: OK p.5, IOZ for A or B, VO = VCC or 0, VCC 6 V, SN74HC245 MAX +/-5 uA (SN54HC245 is +/-10 uA, 25 degC max +/-0.5 uA).

conflicts is empty; remaining_open_items item 2 (per-output and total supply limits are separate) agrees with p.4 listing +/-35 mA and +/-70 mA as separate rows; the other open items are model-process statements, not document claims. All 13 fields are MFR_DATASHEET basis, so there was no DERIVED arithmetic or curve digitization to redo.

Document: Harwin 'Component Specification - M20 Series Connectors', doc C00120, Issue 20, dated 28.11.2022 (cover: November 2022), 4 pages, PDF author Harwin, host content.harwin.com. Blob 886a13d7e7e8 (219467 bytes) equals its ledger content_sha256 and file name (single ledger row, line 422, http 200); pages 1-4 read as text, pp2-3 with word coordinates, nothing rendered.

Record documents entry OK: manufacturer Harwin and revision 'C00120 Issue20,28November2022' match the p1-p3 headers; title 'M20 series connector specification' is a paraphrase of the sheet title (wording only). The sheet is a series-level specification (p2 note: individual components may exceed the ratings, check customer information sheets) and the record scopes it that way, not as a part datasheet.

reference_family 'Harwin M20' OK (p2 header and description; Harwin identified on p1). Scope words 'double-row socket' and 'gold contact finish' are the entry's selection, not stated by the sheet (p2 mentions single/double row only for SMT pin headers, never says 'female', and gives contact finish as 'See individual drawing' / 'Contacts may be gold'); they only narrow the series claim and are hedged by 'actual mate must be selected'.

contact_current_max 3 A OK (p2: 'Current Rating (per contact) ... 3A max', same baseline). The sheet states no temperature or loaded-contact condition and the record claims none; 'individual drawing may specify more' paraphrases the p2 note (customer information sheets).

contact_resistance_initial_max 20 mohm and contact_resistance_conditioned_max 30 mohm OK (p2: '(initial) 20 mohm max', '(after conditioning) 30 mohm max'). The sheet gives no test current, does not define conditioning and never says 'mated', so 'mated contact' in the scope is an interpretation; no extra condition is claimed.

operating_temperature_range [-40,105] degC OK (p2: 'Other ... -40 degC to +105 degC'); M20-106/7 is -25 to +85 degC and is correctly excluded. The sheet never calls M20-106/7 'cable' (2.1 only says 'For Cable connectors: See individual drawing'), so that label is unsupported though the exclusion is right.
contact_durability_operations 300 OK (p3, page cited correctly: 'Gold finish on contact area ... 300 operations'); the scope's tin 50 operations is also on p3.
nominal_contact_pitch 2.54 mm and mating_pin_size 0.64 mm square OK (p2: 'A range of 2.54mm (0.1in) pitch connectors, having 0.64mm (0.025in) square pins and sockets').

conflicts / remaining_open_items / simulation_blockers OK: the sheet has only Dielectric Withstanding Voltage (Voltage Proof) 500/800/1000 V AC for 1 minute (p2) and, per keyword scan of pp1-4, no working voltage, typical contact resistance, thermal resistance, inductance or derating. The Samtec 1000-cycle and 25-cycle comparisons concern other sources and are not checkable here; the Harwin 300-operation statement is verified (p3).
Text integrity: cited spans are black 10 pt, with no annotations and no strike-through vector lines on pp2-3.

compatible_header_series 47053, OK page 1: 'Mates With: 47053 2.54mm Pitch KK Vertical Header, with Friction Lock'.

nominal_contact_pitch 2.54 mm, OK page 1: both 'Pitch - Mating Interface 2.54mm' and 'Pitch - Termination Interface 2.54mm'.

Conflicts and open items: the sheet is a 4-position housing and never mentions 22232021, a voltage rating or contact resistance, so the 'unbound/unresolved' statements hold. The '250V/0..75C vs 500V/-40..80C' item concerns other sources (none of those numbers appear in this sheet) and is not used as a field value, so it is unverifiable here but not a mismatch; the PS-47053-001-001 fetch-failure sentence is process history (the sheet only lists that spec as a separate document on page 1).

Record vs gap-fill: research.field_updates is identical to the audit-evidence field_updates for all 6 fields (value, unit, scope, page, basis, confidence, sources) except that the record adds the default 'detail': null key to each; documents[0] likewise adds 'page': null; conflicts, remaining_open_items, simulation_blockers, bench lists, researched_at and research_result are equal, and record source.document_sha256 equals the gap-fill sha256.

mismatches: remaining_open_items[0] (record research.remaining_open_items and gap-fill 'Remaining open items' bullet 1) says 'Maximum voltage/current and temperature derating are not qualified as max by this datasheet'; page 1 SPECIFICATIONS prints 'rated input current' 2.5 A in the max column (value x-centre 507.3 = max header 507.3; min and typ empty), so the current IS qualified as max and only 'rated input voltage' 24 Vdc is typ-only. temperature_operating [-25, 85] degC: OK p1, 'operating temperature' min -25 and max 85 degC (min and max columns), no other conditions.

The sheet has no text naming sleeve or switch or stating that the contact opens on insertion; the scopes disclose this. PCB layout labels 1#, 2#, 3# confirmed.
